in_hebrew.name: אלטון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם פרטי, שמאלי, חזק, מלך. מקור השם אל- (אל) וטון (עוצמה). יש תמות דומה, אלטון, שמשמעותה 'מלך' ו'עז'.

in_greek.name: Ελτῶν
in_greek.long_meaning: Όνομα, αριστερός, δυνατός, βασιλεύς. Η προέλευση του ονόματος είναι από την ελληνική λέξη 'άλλος' (άλλος) που σημαίνει 'αλλά' και η 'τόνος' (τόνος) που σημαίνει 'χτύπος' ή 'μέγεθος'.

in_latin.name: Elton
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen, dexter, fortis, rex. Origine nomen a 'altus' (altus) quod significat 'altus' et 'tonus' (tonus) quod significat 'sonus' vel 'magnitude'.

in_english.name: Elton
in_english.long_meaning: Name, left, strong, king. Origin from Hebrew 'el' (God) and 'ton' (power) or Greek 'altus' (high) and 'tonus' (sound). Not found in Bible directly. Possibly derived from Old English 'Eald' (old) and 'tun' (enclosure) as Elton in England.

data.cultural_impact: The name Elton may not have had significant cultural impact outside of historical references and personal use. data.spiritual_significance: Elton, derived from the Hebrew name Elath, holds the profound meaning that 'God is my God'. This name is a constant reminder of one's faith and devotion towards the Almighty. In a spiritual context, having the name Elton signifies a deep connection with God and a firm belief in His guidance, protection, and love. It is a name that instills a sense of strength and courage, encouraging the bearer to always remember their faith in God during life's challenges.

historical_references.reference: Elton, a bishop of Lindisfarne, was expelled from his see in 688, during the Synod of Whitby. He was a staunch supporter of the Celtic Christian tradition, while the Synod favored the Roman rite. Elton's expulsion marked the end of Celtic Christianity in England.

Elton, a name borne by several English kings, is derived from the Old English 'Ealda-dun', meaning 'old hill'. One such king was Elthred I, who reigned from 865 to 874. He is known for his efforts to maintain peace and stability within his kingdom, and for his patronage of religious institutions.

modern_usage.modern_context: Elton John is a renowned British singer, songwriter and pianist who has made significant contributions to various music genres including pop and classical music. His music can be easily accessed on popular streaming platform Spotify. Elton's influence extends beyond music as he is also an active user of Instagram, where he shares glimpses into his personal life, fashion sense, and music career. Fashion magazines like Vogue celebrate his iconic style and often feature him on their covers.

name_in_real_life.story: Hannah Elton, a minister in Athens, Greece, shares that their name Elton meaning "God's strength" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Elton: From the Old English word 'ealda' meaning 'old' and 'tun' meaning 'farm' or 'settlement.' In Christian symbolism, Elton may represent the wise elder in a community, who through experience and age, offers guidance and wisdom to others.
